name: @hostbeam/video
description: Hostbeam's launch film, written with Remotion. Outside the npm workspaces on purpose (like apps/raycast): its own lockfile, nothing added to the apps' dependency trees or their open-source notices.

scripts.render: remotion render HostbeamLaunch out/raw-launch.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/raw-launch.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-15:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/hostbeam-launch-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:x: remotion render HostbeamX out/raw-x.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/raw-x.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-15:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/hostbeam-x-16x9.mp4
